Chromatin accessibility (Tn5 insertions per 1,000 nuclei, same scale across tracks) and RNA expression (violins) at stem and cell-cycle genes, with gene model and called peaks; the number of nuclei in each group is shown beside its track. Lgr5 and Olfm4 are detected in 48% and 87% of stem-like FAE nuclei but only 2% and 16% of later FAE nuclei. Stem-like FAE has lower E2F, MYC and G2M target signatures than crypt ISCs (Hallmark NES -2.0, -2.2, -1.7). Use the buttons to switch locus.

Chromatin accessibility (Tn5 insertions per 1,000 nuclei, same scale across tracks) and RNA expression (violins) at NF-kB pathway genes in crypt ISCs, stem-like FAE, all other FAE (later FAE and FAE enterocytes), M cells and proximal enterocytes, with gene model and called peaks. The number of nuclei in each group is shown beside its track. Hallmark TNF-alpha signaling via NF-kB is enriched in stem-like FAE versus crypt ISCs (NES 1.93, FDR 0.012), and RELB and NFKB2 motif accessibility rises from ISCs to stem-like FAE (chromVAR z: RELB 0.19 to 5.25; NFKB2 0.15 to 4.73). Use the buttons to switch locus.
